description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans' MessagePack serialization support, utilizing the Xunit framework to verify serialization, deep copying, and codec functionality for custom message classes and unions.

classes.name: MessagePackCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for MessagePack serialization and deep copy of MyMessagePackClass instances, verifying roundtrip, deep copy, and union handling.

classes.name: MessagePackUnionCodecTests
classes.description: Unit tests for MessagePack union serialization support for IMyMessagePackUnion implementations.

classes.name: MessagePackCodecCopierTests
classes.description: Unit tests for deep copying MyMessagePackClass instances via MessagePack codec.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serializer builder to add MessagePack serialization support.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates a sample instance of MyMessagePackClass for testing.

methods.name: TestValues
methods.description: Provides a set of sample test values including null, shallow, deep, and union instances.

methods.name: MessagePackSerializerDeepCopyTyped
methods.description: Tests deep copying of a strongly-typed MyMessagePackClass object.

methods.name: MessagePackSerializerDeepCopyUntyped
methods.description: Tests deep copying of a MyMessagePackClass object through untyped interface.

methods.name: MessagePackSerializerRoundTripThroughCodec
methods.description: Verifies that an object can be serialized and deserialized correctly via codec.

methods.name: MessagePackSerializerRoundTripThroughUntypedSerializer
methods.description: Verifies roundtrip serialization/deserialization through untyped serializer.

methods.name: CreateValue
methods.description: Creates a sample union value for testing union serialization support.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the serializer builder to add MessagePack serialization support for union types.

methods.name: CreateCopier
methods.description: Creates a deep copier instance for MyMessagePackClass.
